bet.text: Shooter on an elevator: one mechanism scores in the speaker, amp and trap, and the elevator can also pull the robot onto the chain.

demand.text: Its list: the ranking points (win, 18 notes in teleop or 15 with coopertition, 10 endgame points with two robots onstage); the amp; the trap, to make the endgame point likelier; be short enough to pass under the stage, away from defenders and traffic; and shoot over 48 in defenders from the podium.

auto.text: The code lists a 6-note mode, and dynamic 3-note rush autos for the source and amp sides.
The team says it won the autonomous award at each of its three regionals.

cycle.text: The under-bumper intake picks a note off the floor and centers it; rollers hold it until the robot is in position. Cameras on the AprilTags position the robot to score.
It can drive under the stage with the elevator down, and raise it to shoot over defenders.

endgame.text: Carriage hooks pull the robot off the ground until passive hooks near its bottom latch the chain; the elevator is then free to extend to the trap. The robot wants to tip toward the trap.
The elevator holds the trap open and the note reverses out of the back of the shooter.

changed.text: A January alpha robot, all on Falcons, was meant to reduce risk in the shooter and ran a 6-piece routine. Krakens had only just arrived.
The competition robot has Krakens on drive, elevator and shooter.
The first-stage elevator tube is 1/8 in wall, since those tubes dented most after a few competitions.

outcome.text: 47-13-0 in official play; ranked 100 by championship OPR (42.23, Hopper).

facts.text: WCP Swerve X inverted modules with Kraken X60s, X3 gears and a 10-tooth pinion; free speed
Frame 26 by 28 in; 30.5 by 28 in with the intake
Black nitrile tread
Robot weight, around; the question was about weight without batteries or bumpers

solves.text: Collect notes from the ground and center them before the shooter

facts.text: Width
Three 1 in aluminum rollers covered with silicone tubing, 1.3:1; surface speed
Four centering wheels of 3 and 4 in, 4.8:1; surface speed
One bumper side is raised for it

cost.text: Often hands the note to the shooter in a very deformed state

functions.name: Shooter

solves.text: Score in every location with one mechanism, with consistent shots from deformed notes

functions.type: flywheel shooter with spin, on the elevator carriage

facts.text: Two Kraken X60s each spin two sets of 4 in wheels; upduction
Wheels on opposite sides run at different speeds to spin the note
Printed conical wheels and mecanum wheels spread the note inside the shooter
The mecanums do the opposite of centering, so the note expands to its original shape; testing found them and the tapered rollers really important for consistent shots
Tapered rollers are printed PLA wrapped in cat tongue grip tape; compression in the center, none at the sides
The front roller pair is angled down relative to the exit path, for the trap
Six 1 in polycarbonate idler rollers reduce friction on the note
Shooter weight, about

functions.name: Pivot

solves.text: Adjust the shooter angle for speaker, amp and trap

functions.type: chain-driven shooter pivot with gas springs

facts.text: Overall reduction, with a 25:1 MAXPlanetary and a last stage of two #25 chain runs
Two 50 lb gas springs counter the torque of the shooter and dampen it
The springs more than cancel the shooter weight, so backlash stays on one side and the functional backlash is pretty much zero; gears are also shimmed and the chain has inline tensioners
The gas springs also counter the movement of the elevator going up when shooting
A CANcoder is belted directly to the pivot shaft

functions.name: Elevator

solves.text: Move the shooter up and down, and get the robot onstage

functions.type: two-stage continuous rope elevator with overextending carriage

facts.text: Two Kraken X60s; reduction
Rigged internally with UHMWPE rope; 1.5 in printed spools
Crossbars on the base and first stage are lowered so the robot can shoot into the speaker while below stage height
First-stage tube 1/8 in wall, base 1/16 in; 1/16 in wall tube had dented in the first stage of the 2023 robot, and countersunk bolts need the thickness
Climb hooks are integrated in the pivot side plates; passive hooks near the bottom of the robot latch the chain, then the elevator is free

functions.name: AprilTag cameras
functions.type: camera localization with shoot on the move

facts.text: Cameras sense AprilTags to position the robot for scoring
The code release lists shoot on the move
A plate protects the cameras; its ends bend outward so it can flex in a hit without touching them

decisions.because: one mechanism reaches speaker, amp and trap, and the robot can pass under the stage and still shoot over defenders

decisions.choice: Mecanums that do the opposite of centering
decisions.because: forcing a deformed note back to its shape made shots much more consistent
decisions.instead_of: mecanums that center the note, as most intakes do

decisions.choice: One connector on the main CAN line, with insulation-displacement taps
decisions.because: it minimizes connectors on any line that takes down the whole bus if broken
decisions.instead_of: soldering, which causes stress concentrations, is hard to inspect and takes a long time

decisions.because: it was meant to reduce risk in critical mechanical design, this year the shooter, and give software students a robot as quickly as possible

decisions.choice: Develop what you can before the season
decisions.because: the team calls it the key to its early autonomous demonstrations
